from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u001/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7ec26314.py')
text='''from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    """Fill rectangular one-cell frames: odd-sized frames with 7, even with 2."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))

            r0 = min(y for y, _ in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, _ in cells)
            c0 = min(x for _, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for _, x in cells)
            if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
                continue
            cell_set = set(cells)
            perimeter = {
                (y, x)
                for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)
                for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                if y in (r0, r1) or x in (c0, c1)
            }
            if cell_set != perimeter:
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1 - r0 + 1) % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
